svg.title: Same assumptions. Different order.
svg.desc: Two agents start at minus and plus 0.4. Equal influence weights and susceptibility 0.5 anchor them at minus and plus 0.2. Their distance of 0.4 is within confidence bound 0.5, so compromise 0.25 moves them to minus and plus 0.1. In reverse order, initial distance 0.8 exceeds the bound; no exchange occurs, then anchoring leaves minus and plus 0.2. Each axis runs from minus one to plus one. One round, with original anchors fixed.

g.aria-label: One round. Original anchors stay fixed.
